steps.name: publish
argv:
# Required by box_enqueue.courier_problems: the courier pushes from
# farm-out and from nowhere else, and ep2-cnet-probe-0817 rendered
# perfectly and was invisible for two days for want of exactly this step.
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
out_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/b08pose-0819/out"
pay_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/b08pose-0819"
ctl_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/b08pose-0819/src/pipeline/control"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b08-posenet-sample-0819"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
# The HINT travels with the frame: it is the frame's condition, and a
# reader scoring whether the net read it needs to see it at the same
# pixel columns.
files = sorted(glob.glob(out_dir + "/ep2-b08-posenet-sample-0819-posehint.png*")
               + glob.glob(pay_dir + "/prompt.txt")
               + glob.glob(pay_dir + "/negative.txt")
               + glob.glob(ctl_dir + "/b08-openpose-0819.png"))
lines = []
for f in files:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b08-posenet-sample-0819.sha256"), "w",
          newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(sorted(lines)) + "\n")
print("published", len(files), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(files) >= 5 else 1)
